name: Shanghai NAR Industrial Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai NAR Industrial Co., Ltd. operates in China as a developer, producer, and seller of digital printing materials. Its comprehensive product range includes self-adhesive vinyl series, one-way vision films, cold laminating films, glass films, floor graphics, and various wall coverings. The company also offers functional materials such as paint protection, antimicrobial, and magnetic films. With a global presence extending to approximately 90 countries, Shanghai NAR distributes its products, including inkjet inks, under brand names like NAR, INFLEX, BN, PPF, YIFAN, YINXINGZHANJIA, NAR hydrogen, and AIPRINT. Founded in 2002, the company maintains its headquarters in Shanghai, China.
